conditions: The description applies only to the MPL(B) text identified by the printed February 25, 1974 stamp.
limitations: No equivalence is asserted with the September 1972 MPS reference or with Mesa definitions modules, and no contemporary compiler was executed.

statement: The February 1974 MPL(B) text distinguishes program, data and procedure modules. It describes program and data modules as compilation units, with procedure modules declared within program modules.
